title: Un Grand Raccourci (FCP 2026)
synopsis: Facing their family restaurant's closure, two Breton cousins hatch a desperate rat scheme. Meanwhile, two young women rig a local beauty pageant to boost their jewelry brand. Their wild plans inevitably intersect, uniting four dreamers.

synopsis_lang.en: Facing their family restaurant's closure, two Breton cousins hatch a desperate rat scheme. Meanwhile, two young women rig a local beauty pageant to boost their jewelry brand. Their wild plans inevitably intersect, uniting four dreamers.
synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 面對家族餐廳即將結業，住在布列塔尼的兩名表兄弟孤注一擲，策劃了一場偷竊騙局。與此同時，兩名年輕女子為了催谷她們的珠寶品牌，暗中操縱當地的選美比賽。他們的瘋狂大計無可避免地交錯，最終把四個追夢者拉在一起。

cast: Louise Labèque, Sara Montpetit, François Le Bris, Jules Porier
